native_result.query: What kind of demographic disparities exist in median wealth in 1985 among individuals who were ever incarcerated?
native_result.HypoA: Gender disparities exist in median wealth in 1985 among individuals who were ever incarcerated, with males having higher median wealth than females.
native_result.HypoB: Among the 289 NLS-Y79 respondents with any 1985–1994 jail spell, median 1985 composite wealth is $720 and is stratified by race × sex: white/female ≈ $4,100 (n=12), white/male ≈ $2,000 (n=57), hipanic/female ≈ $0 (n=9), hipanic/male ≈ $700 (n=52), black/female ≈ $0 (n=16), black/male ≈ $800 (n=143). Within ever_jailed, pooled white-to-Black median ratio ≈ 6.9× ($2,200 vs $320) and the pooled white-to-Hispanic ratio is undefined (hipanic pooled median = $0). The ever-jailed median is below the corresponding full-sample cell median in every race × sex cell. Findings are descriptive associations, not causal effects, because 1985 wealth precedes most of the 1985–94 jail spells that define ever_jailed; three cells have n < 20 (9, 12, 16) and their medians are unstable.
native_result.WorkflowB: 1. Loaded data/nls_incarceration_processed.csv (12,013 rows × 6 cols; 0 NA). 2. Filtered to ever_jailed == 1 (n = 289), as defined in datasets.json for 1985–1994 jail spells. 3. Grouped by race × sex and computed cell count (n) and median composite_wealth_1985; also computed the overall median within the ever-jailed subset ($720). 4. Computed the same grouping on the full sample as context and the cell-level gap (delta_vs_full). 5. Computed disparity ratios: white vs Black pooled within ever_jailed (2,200 / 320 ≈ 6.88), white vs Hispanic pooled (undefined; hipanic median = $0), and male vs female within each race within ever_jailed (white: 2,000/4,100 ≈ 0.49; black and hipanic: undefined because the female median = $0). 6. No inferential tests, no recoding of the literal 'hipanic' label, negative wealth values retained, no survey weighting. Artifacts saved under artifacts/: analysis_ever_jailed_wealth.py (executed script), cell_medians_ever_jailed.csv (cell table + full-sample medians), disparity_ratios.csv (ratios), overall_ever_jailed.csv (overall median row), summary.md (concise narrative).
